ref_text: 안녕하세요. 오늘은 한국어를 천천히 또박또박 말해 볼게요.

female2.design: A native Korean woman in her late twenties with a standard Seoul accent. Calm, clear, friendly teacher voice, medium pitch, slow and precise pronunciation.

male1.design: A native Korean man in his thirties with a standard Seoul accent. Clear, warm, steady voice, medium-low pitch, slow and precise pronunciation like a language teacher.

male2.design: A native Korean man in his twenties with a standard Seoul accent. Bright, friendly, slightly higher pitch, clear and unhurried pronunciation.
